1. Executive Summary of Root Causes & Architecture Fixes
Priority 1 — Root Cause of Profile Avatar "A" Clipping

Underlying Cause: The profile avatar was pushed beyond the right screen edge due to a combination of two root layout defects: (1) Inside OSNavbar.jsx, the right actions wrapper lacked rigid flex-shrink constraints (shrink-0) and explicit right margin anchoring, allowing center elements to push the avatar outwards; and (2) on mobile viewports (e.g. 390px), non-wrapping title containers in DashboardPage.jsx ("Zynthor IT Agency Overview" + badge = 438px) exceeded the viewport, causing the whole page body to expand to 470px. Because the top navbar had w-full, its right-aligned avatar was pushed into the overflow zone (x > 390px).

Solution Implemented: Implemented shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-2.5 ml-auto on the right container, added w-full max-w-full overflow-x-hidden to the application shell in BusinessOSLayout.jsx, enabled responsive flex-wrapping on page headers, and ensured the profile dropdown is constrained by max-w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)] right-0.

Priority 2 — Root Cause of Dark-Mode Failure (Black Screen Void)

Underlying Cause: Tailwind CSS v4 defaults dark mode styling to @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark). Because @variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *)); was omitted from src/index.css, toggling the .dark class on <html> had zero effect on Tailwind utility classes. Furthermore, components used bg-slate-950 (#020617) canvas and bg-slate-900/70 (#060b1e) card fills, creating less than 3% luminance delta. The result was an amorphous, pitch-black screen void where card boundaries and typography disappeared.

Solution Implemented: Registered the @variant dark directive in Tailwind v4, defined comprehensive CSS variables for Obsidian Luxury surfaces (Canvas: #0B1020, Cards: #172033, Surfaces: #1E293B, Text: #F8FAFC, Card Borders: rgba(255,255,255,0.08)), and applied dark-mode surface overrides across all components. Theme preference is persisted via localStorage (zynthor_theme) and initialized before React mounts to eliminate any flash of unstyled theme (FOUT).

Priority 3 — 100% Vector Transparent Logo

Underlying Cause: Previous logo assets had hardcoded opaque background rectangles and container paddings that produced an unsightly white or dark box against contrasting page backgrounds. Additionally, there was no responsive mechanism to switch between full wordmark and compact emblem.

Solution Implemented: Created src/components/Brand/ZynthorLogo.jsx and updated public/z-logo.svg and public/zynthor-logo.svg as 100% vector SVGs with fill="none" transparent bounding paths. The component natively supports full wordmark mode (for expanded 256px sidebar and desktop navbar) and icon emblem mode (for collapsed 80px sidebar and mobile navbar).
